typescript.notes: Intentional cross-major lane. Published packages are typechecked and their .d.ts emitted under the root workspace TypeScript 5.9.x line (peer floor 5.4.5); the private reference apps run TypeScript 6.0.x. A package-build TS major bump (to 6.x/7.x) is treated as its own dedicated verification pass, not a routine dependency bump — see DEPENDENCY_AUDIT.md.
